thread:
Maria (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock recruitment channels + success metrics for next beta cohort. Proposal: 18–22 partners, 6-week active feedback, 2 customers try Dedicated/private path. Thoughts?
Josh (Research): Channel idea: 40% existing high-usage accounts, 30% platform partners (integrations), 20% carefully screened startups, 10% community/meetup recruits. Keeps signal diversity.
Liam (Eng): We should flag expected engineering effort per partner. If they want Private deployments, that’s +2 sprint equivalents each. Can we cap private requests to 2?
Tara (Solutions): Agreed — negotiate scope: Private = exploratory only, not production rollout. We can offer a sandbox VPC + mock KMS hookup. That reduces infra footprint.
Kevin (Growth): For outreach cadence, recommend 3-touch email + 1 intro call. Incentive: early credits + prioritized roadmap input. We can supply outreach templates.
Ella (Design): Need an onboarding flow that captures early success signals. I propose a "signal matrix" that captures: setup time, feature adoption (API calls/day), qualitative NPS at week 3, and bug/regression count.
Maria (PM): Love the signal matrix. Can we make a simple numeric "commitment score" from those signals for go/no-go at week 4? (e.g., 0–100)
Josh (Research): Yes — weight: setup time 20, API calls 30, NPS 30, bugs 20. Threshold 60 for continued investment. We'll run a small pilot to calibrate weights.
Nate (CS): Also add "time-to-first-success" (TTFS): time from invite to first successful API call. If >72h, flag for concierge help.
Rach (PM-ops): We need clear acceptance criteria for each partner before onboarding. Suggest checklist in onboarding doc and a short screener survey. Draft screener snippet below:
```
1) Primary use case (text gen / embeddings / rerank): ______
2) Expected daily requests in beta (estimate): ______
3) Need for dedicated/private infra? (yes/no) If yes, explain: ______
4) Security/compliance constraints (SOC2 / HIPAA / none): ______
```
Tara (Solutions): That screener looks good. Add a question about "ability to commit engineering time (hours/week)" — we need longitudinal feedback.
Kevin (Growth): Channel-specific ask: for community recruits, lower commit threshold but offer research sessions. For enterprise, require PM/eng signoff.
Liam (Eng): On the engineering side, we should provide a small SDK quickstart + a pre-seeded config for KV cache and batching settings. Saves time and reduces TTFS.
Ella (Design): I'll build a 1-pager onboarding UX and a lightweight in-console checklist that pings CS if TTFS > 72h.
DeployBot: CI deploy to beta-onboarding branch succeeded — 2 artifacts: onboarding-doc-v1, screener-form-v1. :white_check_mark:
Maria (PM): Next steps: (1) finalize screener + signal matrix (by EOD Wed), (2) Kevin to prepare outreach templates (Thu), (3) Ella to ship onboarding 1-pager (Thu), (4) Liam/Tara estimate private sandbox effort (Fri). If anyone can't hit those, ping here.
Josh (Research): I'll run a micro-pilot with 3 internal partners to validate commitment-score calibration next week.
Nate (CS): I'll draft a concierge playbook for flagged partners (TTFS >72h or commitment <60).
Rach (PM-ops): I'll create the invite spreadsheet and tagging columns: channel, persona, infra-need, commitment-score after week 4.
Maria (PM): One negotiation point — if a partner requests feature X during beta, we surface it to roadmap but don't commit timelines. We should add a policy blurb to the invite.
Tara (Solutions): +1. Also clarify support SLAs for beta vs. GA. Beta = best-effort, concierge for top partners only.
Kevin (Growth): Can we offer a short "roadmap juice" session as a sweetener — 30m with product leads? Helps close enterprise yeses.
Ella (Design): I'll add the policy blurb and the roadmap-session CTA to the invite template.
Maria (PM): Cool — if no objections, I'll merge these into the beta playbook and schedule the recruitment kickoff on Mon. :rocket: 
Liam (Eng): No objections. One ask: add a tag for "requires infra changes" so we can capacity-plan.
Rach (PM-ops): Noted. I'll include that column.
Maria (PM): Thanks team — small follow-up: please drop any sample outreach lines or past partner lessons in this thread so Kevin can iterate.
Kevin (Growth): Dropping 2 quick lines: "We're running a small, high-touch beta to shape our Dedicated offering — early access + credits for active feedback. Can we book 20–30 minutes to confirm fit?" and "We prioritize partners who can commit a 6-week feedback window and a short technical contact."
Josh (Research): Past lesson: early customers over-promise time. Add explicit "hours/week" ask and follow up in call to confirm.
Nate (CS): Past lesson: concierge saved 2 partners from churning in pilot — recommend offering 2 concierge touchpoints (week1, week3).
Maria (PM): Perfect. I'll assemble and flag owners. Meeting invite for kickoff going out now. Thanks all.
